cues.head: sweep_locked
cues.note: the riff alone: a gold comet along the arc, the head's spot following it on the wall

cues.head: room_patterns
cues.note: drop 1, the smallest: every beat ripples across the four lamps (blue/pink by chord), room-wide head patterns changing every bar, pops on downbeats only

cues.head: spiral_rise
cues.note: the riff without drums: chase accelerating to 16ths, second comet joins, spiral climbing, strobe in the last two bars, blackout beat

cues.head: figure8
cues.note: drop 2: the same ripple recognised, bigger: inner/outer in two chord colours, off-beat ghosts, pops on beats 1 and 3, prism, the head in a fast figure-8, dropout bar goes black then bursts

cues.head: spot_per_bar
cues.note: half a kit under the riff: soft taps per beat, gold comet, head jumping to a new spot each bar

cues.head: spotlight
cues.note: the pause: one lamp breathing deep blue; then the vocal swells the inner pair in warm colours under a warm open spot, outer pair breathing blue

cues.head: roam_slow
cues.note: chords in, voice out: a blue/pink gradient sliding along the arc, everything gliding, head roaming slowly

cues.head: sweep_locked
cues.note: the bridge: outer pair ducking on every beat and swelling back, inner pair running a 16th-note hat chase, head locked to it

cues.head: head_bloom
cues.note: the filter sweep: dark saturated colour blooming to white as the filter opens, head climbing from the wall to the ceiling with it

cues.head: spiral_rise
cues.note: the riff returns (bar 3's hook): the same accelerating build as before, into the blackout

cues.head: room_patterns
cues.note: the final drop: all four lamps every beat in two chord colours, white downbeats, pops on 1 and 3 with the head popping too, dropout bar, wheel spin for four bars, white-strobe finale

cues.head: park_fade
cues.note: collapse inward to deep blue and dark; head drifts home

note: Avicii - Levels, curated from the arranger's seed-1 draft on 2026-09-13. Edit par/head/params/intensity per cue and re-render with score_show.py --plan.
